name: @mnemosyne-plugins/mnemo-ember
description: Log each cigarette, vape or joint in one tap, see your day on a clock, and ride out a craving with a virtual one, a breathing exercise or a few push-ups. The log lives on your machine; the chat can read it once you let it.
